name: Lastlight Exterior — Reference Gate
subtitle: Supplied lighthouse reference vs Blender-authored Crafted Realms lighthouse
review_note: The pale cylindrical tower, fitted side entry, broad gallery, transparent light-blue lantern crown with dark mullions, red faceted roof, coastal foundation rocks, cliff guardrail and luminous summit signal marking carry every environmental feature from the reference into a readable Crafted Realms composition without copying it.
verdict: PASS — reference identity and game-camera readability accepted
improve: The pictured character remains a runtime actor rather than part of the static environment model; no visible environmental component is unaccounted for.
